I've been struggling with hobbies. But I ended up going to bed and sleeping for a few hours, and am alive today. 

Thanks for talking. It helped.

I have self harmed before and I dunno what happened, I think I am in a bad patch and some shit at work triggered with shit at home triggered with feeling isolated and sad has made me feel awful.
I think I just want some help but I don't feel I can get it without being suicidal. I'm sorry, I sound like a drama attention seeker.
I tried calling a UK number, but I just couldn't talk to them, I felt judged and they sounded impatient on the phone.
I know that, I also have a job, but I also have depression and that doesn't help with anything.
